title: Transillumination to Reduce Post-injection Complications in Aesthetic Medicine
brief_summary: Transillumination (TL) is a noninvasive technique that appears to allow preliminary detection of superficial vascular structures of the face to avoid intravascular HA injection. The purpose of our study was to test the efficacy of TL in terms of its sensitivity to locate vessels in the areas undergoing treatment and to reduce post-injection vascular complications.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients presenting for facial injections of hyaluronic acid

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with a history of allergy to a component of hyaluronic acid
* Patients with arteritis (Horton)
* Patients who have had previous facial surgery
* pregnant or nursing patients
